I'm the AI Portfolio Assistant for Chandana Konduru — an AI Product Manager with 6+ years of experience across B2B SaaS, IoT, healthcare AI, and fintech. Ask me anything about her background!

Chandana is immediately available — no notice period. She's open to AI PM, Product Analyst, Technical PM, and UX-PM hybrid roles. She's on H4-EAD, so no visa sponsorship is needed. Reach her at chandanashree97@gmail.com.
Chandana is based in Omaha, NE and is open to remote, hybrid, or on-site roles across the US. She's led global teams across 5 countries, so timezone flexibility is natural to her.
Chandana holds H4-EAD work authorization — she can start immediately with no visa sponsorship required.

Chandana has hands-on AI/ML PM experience: she raised AI acceptance from 30%→85% at Data Foundry's pharmacovigilance platform, built Scan It Know It using Gemini API (92% accuracy, $0 infra), and shipped Budget Management AI with 68% retention. She works with Gemini, Claude, and GPT APIs directly.

Healthcare is one of Chandana's strongest domains. At Data Foundry she was PM for DF Safety — an AI pharmacovigilance platform achieving 85% AI acceptance (from 30%) and 100% E2B R2/R3 compliance. At Tenet Healthcare she improved medical billing UX with HIPAA-compliant React/Node systems.

At ZKTeco, Chandana led BioTime Cloud 2.0 — a 4-country B2B SaaS transformation (Nigeria, China, Mexico, India) for 10,000+ enterprise users, delivering 35% system performance increase via RESTful API migration. This is her flagship enterprise SaaS case study.

Chandana managed ZKDigiMax-ESL at ZKTeco — an IoT Electronic Shelf Label system for global retail stores. She reduced pricing errors 3% and cut inventory search time 10% through human-centered mobile app design and cross-functional hardware-software PM leadership.

Scan It Know It is Chandana's zero-to-one AI product — scans any product or receipt for instant info. Built with Gemini API: 92% accuracy, <5s response, $0 infrastructure cost, shipped in 3 weeks (June–Feb 2026).
Budget Management is Chandana's AI finance platform — 70% AI-generated code, privacy-first (no bank account required), 68% Day-30 retention, and 10% user spending reduction for beta users.
At NTT Data, Chandana built the mobile-first booking portal for Wyndham Hotels & Resorts — 5% guest engagement increase, 10% support ticket reduction, with offline capability for hotel staff.
At NTT Data for Tenet Healthcare, Chandana improved complex medical billing UX — reducing task confusion 5%, boosting staff productivity 3%, on a HIPAA-compliant React/Node.js platform.
At Experlogix (via NTT Data), Chandana was Developer II on the cloud CPQ platform — proactive monitoring with C# and SQL, DevOps delivery, ensuring high SaaS availability for enterprise customers.

Three standout case studies: (1) BioTime Cloud 2.0 — 35% performance gain, 4-country enterprise SaaS; (2) DF Safety — 85% AI acceptance from 30%, exceptional in regulated healthcare AI; (3) Scan It Know It — zero-to-one AI product in 3 weeks at $0. Each shows a different PM dimension.

Core skills: LLM API integration (Gemini, Claude, GPT), SQL, Power BI, Tableau, Figma, Jira, Confluence, Azure, RESTful APIs, Agile/Scrum, user research, PRD writing, OKRs. Domain expertise: healthcare AI, pharmacovigilance, B2B SaaS, IoT, fintech.

6+ years across: ZKTeco (AI PM, SaaS & IoT, Aug 2023–Aug 2024), Data Foundry (AI/ML PM, Healthcare, 2022–2023), NTT Data/Experlogix (Product Engineer, Feb–Dec 2022), Tenet Healthcare and Wyndham Hotels (Software Developer/Engineer, 2020–2022). Plus two personal AI products built in 2025–2026.

Chandana has shipped products across USA, India, Nigeria, China, and Mexico — primarily through the 4-country SaaS rollout at ZKTeco. She's experienced managing cross-cultural stakeholder needs and region-specific product customization. She has not worked in the UK.
